endpoints.short_description: Create a new social media platform record

It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ISocialMediaPlatformRepository.IsSocialMediaPlatformDuplicateAsync, ISocialMediaPlatformRepository.CreateSocialMediaPlatformAsync. Persists changes to: SocialMediaPlatform: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Platform name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.platform_name)]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

error_handling.business_rule_errors: Social media platform with this name already exists. [when dupcheck]
